capability.title: Can add inventory items
capability.description: Allow this person — and only this person — to add parts to the warehouses they can access. Their role and other users on the same role are not changed.

source.grant: enabled by the owner for this person
source.deny: disabled by the owner for this person
source.none: not part of the person's role

mapping.title: Map lines to inventory
mapping.hint: Stock is only issued against catalogue items. Choose the inventory item for each free-text line.
mapping.catalogueFailed: Could not load this warehouse's items.

approve.title: Approve quantities
approve.hint: Approve each part in full, approve a smaller quantity, or mark it as not available. Nothing leaves the stock until the parts are issued.
approve.short: More than the current stock — issuing will be refused until stock is added.
